directives.title: Code Review
directives.text: Review this code for bugs, performance issues, and best practices. Be thorough but concise.

directives.title: Debug Helper
directives.text: Help me debug this issue. Ask clarifying questions if needed, then provide step-by-step debugging approach.

directives.title: Doc Writer
directives.text: Write clear documentation for this code/function. Include purpose, parameters, return values, and examples.

directives.title: Refactor Guide
directives.text: Suggest refactoring improvements for readability, maintainability, and performance. Show before/after.

directives.title: Test Generator
directives.text: Generate comprehensive unit tests for this code. Cover edge cases, happy path, and error conditions.

directives.title: Security Audit
directives.text: Analyze this code for security vulnerabilities. Check for injection, auth bypass, data exposure, etc.
